scope: Shared experiment infrastructure for BOTH arms. Two global unit-acquisition slots; each runs its iOS/Android cases in parallel. Complete own-D0 cohort must seal before model reviews. Public common-D0 audits may overlap read-only reviews/one-repair phases in separate audit checkouts; no common grade/hidden evidence released before all own-FINAL public endpoints. Common FINAL and pair acquisitions may overlap allowed independent grading stages.
resource_guard: Cross-process POSIX slot locks keep at most two unit acquisitions active even if a later batch queues. Source/phase cohort gates remain unchanged.
attribution: Common scheduling/resource wait, not v7 treatment; include all real queue waits/contention in primary and full experiment wall and separately report audit SDK work. No native sampling, source, design, expected value, tool version or phase feedback change.
registration_context: Before any original selfreview/product grading; current progress monitored only for command exits/frame counts. Initial own-D0 batch v1 already constrained to two threads; exact pre-lock launcher preserved.
